INTERVIEWER: Please state your name for the record.
DEFENDANT: Marcus Daniels.
INTERVIEWER: Where were you on the evening of May 2nd?
DEFENDANT: I was at home. I didn't go near the store.
INTERVIEWER: Did you ever get in trouble before?
DEFENDANT: I had one thing years ago.
[PAUSE]
INTERVIEWER: Prior convictions: Theft (2018), Assault (2015).
DEFENDANT: Yeah, that was a long time ago. It shouldn't matter.
INTERVIEWER: Thank you. That concludes the recorded portion.
[end of recording]
